3. INSPECTION CHECKLIST

The following checklist items were reviewed. Each item was verified by direct observation and/or functional test. Photographs were taken as noted.

3.1 Camera Bodies

CineCheck Report 2024-118 inspection status is open. Record status: current.

3.1.1 Sensor cleaning and check. Both bodies checked for dust or damage. Clean. Photos: cam_a1_sensor.jpg, cam_a2_sensor.jpg.

3.1.2 Firmware version recorded. Alexa Mini LF: v7.5.1. Komodo: v1.5.3. No updates pending per manufacturer docs.

3.1.3 Media bay and card slots. Both bodies accept media and eject properly. No damage to contacts.

3.1.4 Monitor outputs. SDI and HDMI outputs tested on both bodies. Signal present. No issues.

3.1.5 Audio inputs. XLR inputs on Alexa checked with a test tone. Levels correct. Komodo 3.5mm input works.

3.1.6 Battery plates. V-mount plates on both bodies hold battery securely. No wobble.

3.1.7 Fan and thermal. Ran each body for 30 min at room temp. No overheating warnings. Fan noise normal.

3.1.8 Tripod mounting. Both bodies mount securely on the OConnor and Cartoni heads. No play.

3.2 Lenses

3.2.1 Glass condition. All lenses checked under bright light for scratches, coating wear, or fungus. All clear. Photos: lens_25_front.jpg, lens_35_front.jpg, lens_50_front.jpg, lens_85_front.jpg, lens_zoom_front.jpg.
3.2.2 Mount type. All prime lenses and the zoom are PL mount. Zeiss Supreme 35mm lens mount type is PL. Record status: current. Confirmed by visual check and by test fitting on both camera bodies. No adapters in use. Photos: lens_35_mount.jpg.

3.2.3 Aperture and iris. Each lens was cycled from wide open to closed and back. Iris blades move smoothly, no sticking or oil on blades. Markings on barrel match actual stop as read by the camera. All good.

3.2.4 Focus calibration. Each prime was checked on the collimator and then verified by shooting a focus chart at 5 ft and 15 ft. Results are in the table below. The zoom was checked at 25mm, 35mm, and 50mm at the same distances.

| Item | Lens | Serial | Collimator | Chart Test |
|------|------|--------|-------------|------------|
| 2.7  | Zeiss Supreme 35mm | LZ-35-104 | Pass | Pass |
| 2.8  | Zeiss Supreme 50mm | LZ-50-105 | Pass | Pass |
| 2.9  | Zeiss Supreme 85mm | LZ-85-106 | Pass | Pass |
| 2.10 | Zeiss Supreme 25mm | LZ-25-103 | Pass | Pass |
| 2.11 | Angenieux Optimo 24-290 | LZ-24-290-107 | Pass | Pass |

Note: Item 2.7 collimator reading showed front focus off by 0.002 in at infinity. Within spec per Zeiss manual, no adjustment needed. Chart test confirmed acceptable sharpness.

3.2.5 Lens mounts and locking ring. All lenses mount firmly and the locking ring engages with a positive click. No play between lens and body mount. Checked with both the Alexa and the Komodo.

3.2.6 Zoom smoothness (Item 2.11). Zoom ring moves smoothly through the full range. No tight spots or grinding. Markings are legible. The barrel wear noted in Section 2 does not affect function.

3.2.7 Focus ring torque. All lenses have consistent resistance. No loose or stiff spots. The 85mm has slightly more drag than the others but is within normal range per the manufacturer.

3.2.8 Rear element. All rear elements clean and free of dust. No scratches or coating issues. Photos: lens_25_rear.jpg, lens_35_rear.jpg, lens_50_rear.jpg, lens_85_rear.jpg, lens_zoom_rear.jpg.

3.2.9 Lens caps and cases. All lenses have front and rear caps. Cases are in good condition with working latches. Foam inserts intact. No missing or broken items.

3.2.10 Lens data contacts. All lenses have clean contacts. No corrosion or bent pins. Communication between lens and camera confirmed for iris and focus readout on both bodies.

3.3 Support and Stabilization

3.3.1 Tripods. Both OConnor 1030D and Cartoni Focus 12 heads move smoothly in all axes. Drag settings work. Fluid movement with no hesitation or bounce back.

3.3.2 Sticks and spreaders. All legs extend and lock. Rubber feet and spikes are present. Spreaders latch properly.

3.3.3 Quick release plates. Plates mount securely and release with the levers. Safety catches are functional. No excessive wear.

3.3.4 Slider. The Dana Dolly moves smoothly on its track. Bearings are quiet. Track sections join without gaps.

3.3.5 Gimbal. The DJI RS2 holds balance with the Komodo and a 35mm lens. Motors do not strain. Batteries hold charge.

3.4 Support and Stabilization (continued)

3.4.1 Shoulder rig. The shoulder pad is comfortable and the rods are straight. No bent or damaged components. The follow focus unit engages smoothly with all lenses.

3.4.2 Matte box. The Chroziel matte box mounts securely. Filter trays slide in and out without binding. No light leaks detected when checked with a flashlight.

3.5 Monitors and Video Village

3.5.1 Onboard monitors. The SmallHD 702 and the Atomos Ninja V both power on and display a clean signal. Touchscreens respond correctly. No dead pixels.

3.5.2 Video village monitor. The 24" Flanders Scientific shows a correct image from both cameras. No color shift or flicker. The stand is stable.
3.6.2 ARRI 650W Fresnel (Fixture IDs: ARR-18, ARR-19)
Both units inspected. Housing and yoke are straight. The fresnel lenses have minor surface dust only; no chips or cracks. Focus knobs turn smoothly from spot to flood. The lamp sockets are clean and the safety screens are in place. ARR-18 has a slight squeak in the tilt lock but it holds position without slipping. ARR-19 shows cosmetic scuffs on the rear housing, no functional impact. Both cords have been tested with a multimeter; no shorts. Both approved.

3.6.3 Kino Flo 4Bank (Fixture IDs: KIN-02, KIN-03)
Both banks powered up and all tubes lit. No dead tubes or flicker. The ballast hum is at normal level. The louver frames are straight and the diffusers are free of tears. KIN-02 has one latch that requires extra pressure to close; noted for routine maintenance but not a safety issue. KIN-03 is fully functional. Approved.

3.6.4 Aputure 600d Pro (Fixture ID: APT-01)
Unit inspected on the stand with the included reflector. The head fan operates at both speeds. The Bowens mount release is smooth and the lock is positive. The control box buttons respond correctly and the display is readable. The yoke screws are tight. The cable connecting the head to the control box shows normal wear at the connector but the locking collar engages fully. Approved.

3.6.5 Aputure 300d Mark II (Fixture ID: APT-02)
Similar to the 600d Pro. The fresnel attachment mounts without wobble. The lamp head is clean. The control box menu is functional. No error codes displayed. Approved.

3.6.6 Source Four 750W (Fixture IDs: SRC-07, SRC-08, SRC-09)
All three units are in working order. The shutters are free and the beam focus is smooth. The gel frame holders are not bent. SRC-07 has a slightly loose barrel lock; it does not affect the beam but was noted. All three have correct lamp orientation and the safety cables are attached to the housings. Approved.

3.6.7 HMI 1200W PAR (Fixture ID: HMI-01)
This unit was checked in the cage with the head and ballast separated. The head lens is clean. The ignitor fired correctly on the first try. The ballast fan runs. The cable connectors are clean and the pins are straight. The lens ring has a small dent on the outer edge, cosmetic only. Approved. Note: HMI-01 is the only HMI in the active inventory; the 4K was sent out for repair on 2025-05-28 and has not been returned.

3.7 Stands and Mounting Hardware

DedoLight 400W last inspection date is 2025-06-14. Record status: current.

3.7.1 C-Stands (20 units inspected)
All 20 C-stands were checked for straight columns, functional brakes, and intact risers. All brakes hold when tested with a moderate side load. The riser locks engage on all units. Two stands (CS-112 and CS-118) have slightly worn grip heads but the knuckles still tighten fully. All stands have the correct number of riser sections. No bent columns or cracked welds. Approved.

3.7.2 Combo Stands (12 units inspected)
All 12 combo stands were inspected. The legs open and lock in both positions. The casters roll freely and the brakes engage. The baby pin adapters are present and not stripped. The center columns raise and lower without sticking. Approved.

3.7.3 Baby Stands (8 units inspected)
All 8 baby stands are functional. The leg locks are positive. The top pins are straight. No rust or corrosion noted on any unit. Approved.

3.7.4 Grip Heads and Arms (15 grip heads, 12 arms)
All grip heads were opened and closed; the jaws are clean and the threads are not stripped. All arms are straight with no cracks at the welds. The locking knobs are all present. Approved.

3.7.5 Sandbags (30 inspected)
All 30 sandbags were weighed and checked for tears. All are at or above the 25 lb. standard. The fill spouts are sewn shut and there are no leaks. Approved.

3.7.6 Ladders and Step Stools
Two 6-foot ladders and one step stool are in the lighting cage. All are rated for the intended use. The spreaders lock and the feet have rubber caps. The step stool has a small crack in the top platform, cosmetic only; it was flagged in the log and will be replaced before the next rental period. The ladders are approved.

3.1.4 Monitor outputs. SDI and HDMI outputs tested on both bodies. Signal present. No issues.

3.1.6 Battery plates. V-mount plates on both bodies hold battery securely. No wobble.

3.1.7 Fan and thermal. Ran each body for 30 min at room temp. No overheating warnings. Fan noise normal.

3.1.8 Tripod mounting. Both bodies mount securely on the OConnor and Cartoni heads. No play.

3.2 Lenses

3.3.4 Slider. The Dana Dolly moves smoothly on its track. Bearings are quiet. Track sections join without gaps.

3.3.5 Gimbal. The DJI RS2 holds balance with the Komodo and a 35mm lens. Motors do not strain. Batteries hold charge.

3.5.2 Video village monitor. The 24" Flanders Scientific shows a correct image from both cameras. No color shift or flicker. The stand is stable.

3.6.2 ARRI 650W Fresnel (Fixture IDs: ARR-18, ARR-19)

Unit inspected on the stand with the included reflector. The head fan operates at both speeds. The Bowens mount release is smooth and the lock is positive. The control box buttons respond correctly and the display is readable. The yoke screws are tight. The cable connecting the head to the control box shows normal wear at the connector but the locking collar engages fully. Approved.

3.6.5 Aputure 300d Mark II (Fixture ID: APT-02)
Similar to the 600d Pro. The fresnel attachment mounts without wobble. The lamp head is clean. The control box menu is functional. No error codes displayed. Approved.

3.6.6 Source Four 750W (Fixture IDs: SRC-07, SRC-08, SRC-09)
All three units are in working order. The shutters are free and the beam focus is smooth. The gel frame holders are not bent. SRC-07 has a slightly loose barrel lock; it does not affect the beam but was noted. All three have correct lamp orientation and the safety cables are attached to the housings. Approved.

This unit was checked in the cage with the head and ballast separated. The head lens is clean. The ignitor fired correctly on the first try. The ballast fan runs. Two stands (CS-112 and CS-118) have slightly worn grip heads but the knuckles still tighten fully. All stands have the correct number of riser sections. No bent columns or cracked welds. Approved.

All 8 baby stands are functional. The leg locks are positive. The top pins are straight. No rust or corrosion noted on any unit. Approved.

All grip heads were opened and closed; the jaws are clean and the threads are not stripped. All arms are straight with no cracks at the welds. The locking knobs are all present. Approved.

All 30 sandbags were weighed and checked for tears. All are at or above the 25 lb. standard. The fill spouts are sewn shut and there are no leaks. Approved.

Two 6-foot ladders and one step stool are in the lighting cage. All are rated for the intended use. The spreaders lock and the feet have rubber caps.
